stem: A greenhouse crew will perform physically demanding work during a hot afternoon while wearing required protective clothing. What should the work plan account for?
choices: Water access, recovery breaks or cooling, workload, environmental conditions, and the added heat burden of PPE
Only whether workers say they feel thirsty
Removing required PPE whenever the work feels uncomfortable
rationale: Heat risk depends on environment, workload, clothing or PPE, hydration and recovery. Required PPE should not simply be abandoned; the work plan should control the combined heat burden.
